definition_akan: Akan yɛ din a wɔde frɛ nnipa ne kasa ne amammerɛ akuw a wɔwɔ Abibirem Atɔeɛ.
definition_english: Akan refers to a major cultural and linguistic identity in West Africa.
explanation_akan: Akan nipasu ka kasa, abusua, amammerɛ, abakɔsɛm, gyinapɛn ne asetena mu nkitahodie ho.
examples_akan: Akan nipasu wɔ kasa ne amammerɛ mu.
examples_english: Akan identity is expressed through language and culture.

definition_akan: Akanfoɔ yɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Akan kasa ne amammerɛ mu nkitahodie.
definition_english: Akan people are communities associated with Akan languages and cultural traditions.
explanation_akan: Akanfoɔ wɔ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ wɔ Ghana ne Abibirem Atɔeɛ, na wɔn amammerɛ wɔ nsonsonoeɛ wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Akanfoɔ wɔ Ghana ne Abibirem Atɔeɛ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ.
examples_english: Akan people live in different parts of Ghana and West Africa.

definition_akan: Akan amammerɛ yɛ amanneɛ, gyinapɛn, kasa, gyidie ne asetena mu nneyɛeɛ a wɔde kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
definition_english: Akan culture consists of customs, values, language, beliefs, and practices transmitted across generations.
explanation_akan: Akan amammerɛ ka abusua, kasa, aduane, ntoma, afahyɛ, nnwom, anansesɛm ne obu ho.
examples_akan: Akan amammerɛ wɔ nneɛma pii a ɛka ho.
examples_english: Akan culture includes many forms of social and cultural expression.

definition_akan: Akanfoɔ asetena yɛ ɔkwan ahodoɔ a Akanfoɔ fa so tena, di nkitaho na wɔyɛ wɔn amammerɛ mu dwumadie.
definition_english: Akan way of life refers to patterns of living, social interaction, and cultural practice among Akan communities.
explanation_akan: Asetena mu nneɛma ka abusua, adwuma, kasa, amanneɛ, afahyɛ ne mpɔtam mu nkabom ho.
examples_akan: Akanfoɔ asetena wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam nkabom mu.
examples_english: Akan life includes family and community relationships.
question_patterns: What is the Akan way of life?

definition_akan: Abusua yɛ nnipa a wɔnam abusua mu abusuabɔ so wɔ ayɔnkofa.
definition_english: Abusua refers to family and kinship relationships.
explanation_akan: Abusua yɛ Akan asetena mu fapem na ɛka ɔboa, asɛyɛdeɛ ne abusua mu nkitahodie ho.
examples_akan: Abusuafoɔ boa wɔn ho wɔ ahohiahia mu.
examples_english: Family members support one another during difficult times.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na abusua ho hia?
What is family in Akan culture?

definition_akan: Matrilineal abusua yɛ abusua nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ɛna afam so kyerɛ abusua mu nkitahodie wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu.
definition_english: Matrilineal kinship traces important family relationships through the maternal line.
explanation_akan: Akan abusua nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ mmeaeɛ pii mu ma ɛna afam so nya dwuma wɔ abusua mu nkitahodie ne agyapadeɛ mu.
examples_akan: Abusua mu nkitahodie betumi afa ɛna afam so.
examples_english: Kinship relationships may be traced through the maternal line.

definition_akan: Abusua panyin yɛ ɔpanyin a ɔwɔ abusua mu dwuma wɔ afotuo ne abusua nsɛm mu.
definition_english: A family elder is a respected senior person who helps guide family affairs.
explanation_akan: Abusua panyin betumi de osuahunu ne afotuo aboa abusua no wɔ nsɛm ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Abusua panyin de afotuo ma abusuafoɔ.
examples_english: A family elder gives advice to relatives.

definition_akan: Abusuafoɔ yɛ nnipa a wɔka abusua baako anaa wɔwɔ abusua mu abusuabɔ.
definition_english: Relatives are people connected through a family or kinship relationship.
explanation_akan: Abusuafoɔ betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔ ayie, awareɛ, afahyɛ ne nsɛnnennen mu.
examples_akan: Abusuafoɔ hyia wɔ abusua dwumadie ase.
examples_english: Relatives gather during family occasions.

definition_akan: Abusua mu ayɔnkofa yɛ abusuabɔ ne nkitahodie a ɛda abusuafoɔ ntam.
definition_english: Family relationship refers to connections and interactions among relatives.
explanation_akan: Abusua mu ayɔnkofa betumi akɔ so denam mmoa, afotuo, nkitahodie ne dwumadie a wɔyɛ bom so.
examples_akan: Abusua mu ayɔnkofa betumi ayɛ den denam mmoa so.
examples_english: Family relationships can become stronger through mutual support.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusuafoɔ hyɛ wɔn ho den?

definition_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ yɛ nnipa a wɔn mfeɛ, osuahunu ne nyansa ma wɔwɔ dwuma titire wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam mu.
definition_english: Elders are respected members of a family or community whose experience gives them important roles.
explanation_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de afotuo ma mmofra, siesie ntam na wɔboa ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de afotuo ma mmofra.
examples_english: Elders advise younger people.

definition_akan: Obu yɛ suban a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi bu nnipa, mpanyimfoɔ ne afoforo.
definition_english: Respect is a social value expressed toward elders and other people.
explanation_akan: Obu ne ahobrɛaseɛ yɛ Akan asetena mu gyinapɛn a ɛboa ma nkurɔfoɔ tena asomdwoeɛ mu.
examples_akan: Mmofra sua sɛ wɔmmfa obu nni mpanyimfoɔ anim.
examples_english: Children are taught to show respect toward elders.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na obu ho hia?

definition_akan: Ahobrɛaseɛ yɛ suban a obi de no fam ase na ɔnnyɛ ne ho kɛseɛ wɔ afoforo anim.
definition_english: Humility is the quality of behaving modestly and without excessive pride.
explanation_akan: Akan asetena mu ahobrɛaseɛ taa ne obu, ntie ne nkitahodie pa bom.
examples_akan: Ahobrɛaseɛ boa ma nnipa tena asomdwoeɛ mu.
examples_english: Humility can support peaceful relationships.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na ahobrɛaseɛ ho hia?

definition_akan: Ayɔnkofa yɛ nkitahodie a ɛda nnipa anaa abusuafoɔ ntam.
definition_english: Ayɔnkofa refers to relationships and social connections between people.
explanation_akan: Akan asetena mu ayɔnkofa betumi akɔ so wɔ abusua, mpɔtam, awareɛ ne adamfoɔsɛm mu.
examples_akan: Ayɔnkofa pa boa ma mpɔtam no yɛ baako.
examples_english: Good social relationships help communities remain united.
question_patterns: Dɛn na ɛma ayɔnkofa yɛ den?

definition_akan: Tie mpanyimfoɔ yɛ suban a mmofra anaa nkurɔfoɔ tie afotuo ne nsɛm a mpanyimfoɔ ka.
definition_english: Listening to elders refers to paying attention to the advice and guidance of respected senior people.
explanation_akan: Wɔ Akan asetena mu no, tie ne ntieɛ betumi ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so sua nyansa ne osuahunu.
examples_akan: Abofra tie ne panyin afotuo.
examples_english: A child listens to an elder's advice.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na tie mpanyimfoɔ ho hia?
Dɛn na mmofra sua firi mpanyimfoɔ hɔ?

definition_akan: Ahennie yɛ Akan amammerɛ mu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ahemfoɔ ne mpanyimfoɔ sohwɛ ho.
definition_english: Chieftaincy is a traditional leadership institution involving chiefs and elders.
explanation_akan: Ahennie wɔ dwuma wɔ amammerɛ, afotuo, mpɔtam mu asomdwoeɛ ne amanneɛ mu.
examples_akan: Ɔhene ne mpanyimfoɔ boa ma wɔhwɛ mpɔtam no nsɛm so.
examples_english: The chief and elders help oversee community affairs.

definition_akan: Ɔhene yɛ ɔbarima a ɔdi mpɔtam anaa amanneɛ mu ahennie dwuma wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu.
definition_english: A chief is a male traditional leader within an Akan traditional community.
explanation_akan: Ɔhene ne mpanyimfoɔ yɛ adwuma bom wɔ amanneɛ, afotuo ne mpɔtam mu nsɛm ho.
examples_akan: Ɔhene ne mpanyimfoɔ hyia di mpɔtam no nsɛm ho dwuma.
examples_english: The chief and elders meet to discuss community matters.

definition_akan: Ɔbaahemaa yɛ ɔbaa a ɔwɔ dwuma titire wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu ahennie anaa mpɔtam mu.
definition_english: A queenmother is a female traditional leader with important community and cultural responsibilities.
explanation_akan: Ɔbaahemaa betumi de afotuo ama mpɔtam no na wadi mmea ne mmofra ho nsɛm anim.
examples_akan: Ɔbaahemaa de afotuo ma mpɔtam no.
examples_english: The queenmother advises the community.

definition_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ ahemfie yɛ mpanyimfoɔ a wɔboa ɔhene wɔ mpɔtam mu nsɛm ne afotuo mu.
definition_english: A council of elders is a group of respected elders who advise traditional leadership.
explanation_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ betumi de osuahunu ne amanneɛ ho nimdeɛ aboa ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de afotuo ma ɔhene.
examples_english: Elders advise the chief.
question_patterns: Dɛn ne mpanyimfoɔ dwuma wɔ ahennie mu?

definition_akan: Ahemfie yɛ beaeɛ a ɔhene ne ne mpanyimfoɔ di amammerɛ mu dwuma na wɔdi mpɔtam nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ.
definition_english: Ahemfie is a traditional palace or royal setting associated with the chief and traditional leadership.
explanation_akan: Ahemfie betumi ayɛ beaeɛ a amanneɛ, afotuo ne mpɔtam mu nhyiamɔ kɔ so.
examples_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ hyia wɔ ahemfie wɔ dwumadie bi ase.
examples_english: Community members may gather at the palace for cultural activities.

definition_akan: Afahyɛ yɛ amammerɛ mu dwumadie a wɔyɛ de kae abakɔsɛm, nyameaseda anaa adeɛ titire.
definition_english: A festival is a cultural occasion held for remembrance, thanksgiving, or an important purpose.
explanation_akan: Afahyɛ ma mpɔtamfoɔ hyia, yɛ amanneɛ na wɔhyɛ wɔn amammerɛ mu nkabom den.
examples_akan: Afahyɛ ma abusua ne mpɔtamfoɔ hyia.
examples_english: Festivals bring families and communities together.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na Akanfoɔ yɛ afahyɛ?

definition_akan: Afahyɛ bi wɔ abakɔsɛm a ɛkyerɛ nea enti a mpɔtam bi fii ase yɛɛ afahyɛ no.
definition_english: Some festivals have historical origins explaining why communities established them.
explanation_akan: Afahyɛ betumi ama awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ ate wɔn mpɔtam no abakɔsɛm.
examples_akan: Afahyɛ ma mmofra sua wɔn mpɔtam abakɔsɛm.
examples_english: Festivals can help younger generations learn community history.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na afahyɛ bi wɔ hɔ?

definition_akan: Afahyɛ nkabom yɛ sɛnea afahyɛ boa ma abusua ne mpɔtamfoɔ hyia na wɔyɛ adeɛ bom.
definition_english: Festival solidarity refers to the way festivals encourage families and communities to unite.
explanation_akan: Afahyɛ ma nnipa a wɔte mmeaeɛ foforɔ betumi asan aba wɔn mpɔtam ahyia.
examples_akan: Nnipa a wɔatu akɔ baabi foforɔ betumi aba afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: People who have moved elsewhere may return for festivals.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afahyɛ ma nkabom?

definition_akan: Afahyɛ amanneɛ yɛ nneyɛeɛ ne amanneɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ afahyɛ berɛ mu.
definition_english: Festival customs are practices and ceremonies carried out during a festival.
explanation_akan: Afahyɛ amanneɛ betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mpɔtam ne afahyɛ ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Afahyɛ amanneɛ bi ka nnwom ne asaw ho.
examples_english: Some festival customs include music and dance.
question_patterns: Dɛn na wɔyɛ wɔ afahyɛ ase?

definition_akan: Din to yɛ amanneɛ a wɔde ma abofra din na wɔde no ba abusua ne mpɔtam mu.
definition_english: A naming ceremony is a traditional practice for formally giving a child a name and introducing the child to the community.
explanation_akan: Din ho hia wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu na ɛtumi ne awoɔ da, abusua ne abusua no anidasoɔ wɔ abofra no ho di nkitahodie.
examples_akan: Abusuafoɔ hyia wɔ din to ase.
examples_english: Family members gather for a naming ceremony.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na din ho hia?

definition_akan: Awoɔ da din yɛ din a ɛfa da a wɔwoo abofra no ho wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu.
definition_english: A day-of-birth name is a name associated with the day on which a child was born.
explanation_akan: Akan din ahodoɔ bi wɔ nkitahodie a ɛda wɔn awoɔ da ne din ntam.
examples_akan: Abusua betumi de awoɔ da adi dwuma wɔ abofra din mu.
examples_english: A family may use the day of birth in naming a child.
question_patterns: How does birth day relate to Akan naming?

definition_akan: Abofra din yɛ din a abusua de frɛ abofra no na ɛma no nipasu wɔ ɔmanfoɔ mu.
definition_english: A child's name is the name by which the child is identified within family and society.
explanation_akan: Din betumi akyerɛ abusua, awoɔ da, anidasoɔ anaa asɛm bi a ɛfa n'awoɔ ho.
examples_akan: Abusua no paw abofra din wɔ amanneɛ mu.
examples_english: The family chooses a child's name through a cultural process.
question_patterns: Dɛn na Akan din betumi akyerɛ?

definition_akan: Din ne abusua yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda obi din ne abusua a ɔfiri mu ntam.
definition_english: Name and family identity describes the connection between a person's name and family identity.
explanation_akan: Akan din betumi ama obi ada abusua anaa amammerɛ mu nkitahodie adi.
examples_akan: Din bi betumi ama nnipa ahu abusua mu nkitahodie.
examples_english: A name may reflect family or cultural connections.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na din ne abusua wɔ abusuabɔ?

definition_akan: Awareɛ yɛ ayɔnkofa a ɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ne wɔn mmusua bom wɔ amanneɛ ne asɛyɛdeɛ mu.
definition_english: Marriage is a relationship connecting a man, woman, and their families through recognized social responsibilities.
explanation_akan: Akan awareɛ taa ka mmusua baanu bom na ɛwɔ afotuo ne amanneɛ.
examples_akan: Awareɛ ka mmusua baanu bom.
examples_english: Marriage connects two families.

definition_akan: Awareɛ amanneɛ yɛ nneyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a abusua de di awareɛ ho dwuma.
definition_english: Marriage customs are practices and procedures associated with marriage.
explanation_akan: Akan mpɔtam ahodoɔ betumi anya awareɛ amanneɛ a ɛsono wɔn ho wɔ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Awareɛ amanneɛ betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ abusua ahodoɔ mu.
examples_english: Marriage customs can differ among communities and families.
question_patterns: How do Akan marriage customs differ?

definition_akan: Awarefoɔ yɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa a wɔaware.
definition_english: A married couple refers to two people joined in marriage.
explanation_akan: Akan asetena mu awarefoɔ wɔ asɛyɛdeɛ wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho ne wɔn mmusua anim.
examples_akan: Awarefoɔ nya asɛyɛdeɛ wɔ wɔn abusua anim.
examples_english: Married couples have responsibilities toward their families.

definition_akan: Awareɛ ne abusua yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda awareɛ ne mmusua baanu a wɔde awareɛ ka wɔn ho ntam.
definition_english: Marriage and family describes the relationship between marriage and the families connected through it.
explanation_akan: Akan awareɛ betumi ama mmusua baanu anya nkitahodie foforɔ.
examples_akan: Awareɛ ma mmusua baanu nya ayɔnkofa.
examples_english: Marriage can create relationships between two families.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awareɛ ka mmusua bom?

definition_akan: Ayie yɛ amanneɛ a abusua ne mpɔtam yɛ de di awufoɔ ni na wɔkyerɛ awerɛhow.
definition_english: A funeral is a cultural ceremony for honouring the deceased and expressing grief.
explanation_akan: Ayie mu dwumadie betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Abusuafoɔ hyia di awufoɔ ni.
examples_english: Family members gather to honour the deceased.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na Akanfoɔ yɛ ayie?

definition_akan: Ayie nnwom yɛ nnwom a wɔto wɔ ayie mu de da awerɛhow, nkaeɛ anaa afotuo adi.
definition_english: Funeral songs are songs performed during funerals to express grief, remembrance, or reflection.
explanation_akan: Nnwom wɔ dwuma wɔ Akan ayie mu na ne nsɛm betumi ama nkurɔfoɔ asusuw ɔbra ne ɔwu ho.
examples_akan: Wɔto nnwom wɔ ayie ase.
examples_english: Songs may be performed during funerals.
question_patterns: Why are songs used at funerals?

definition_akan: Awufoɔ nkaeɛ yɛ sɛnea abusua ne mpɔtam ka wɔn a wɔawuwu no ho asɛm na wɔkae wɔn abrabɔ.
definition_english: Remembrance of the deceased is the act of recalling and honouring those who have died.
explanation_akan: Nkaeɛ ma abusuafoɔ tumi ka ɔno a wawuo no suban, ne dwuma ne ne nkaeɛ ho asɛm.
examples_akan: Abusuafoɔ ka awufoɔ no ho nsɛm wɔ ayie mu.
examples_english: Family members talk about the deceased during funeral activities.

definition_akan: Ayie mu nkabom yɛ sɛnea abusua ne mpɔtamfoɔ bom boa abusua a wɔayera wɔn dɔfoɔ.
definition_english: Funeral solidarity refers to the support families receive from relatives and community members during funerals.
explanation_akan: Nkabom betumi ada adi wɔ mmoa, adwuma, afotuo ne ɔkyɛfa mu.
examples_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ boa abusua no wɔ ayie mu.
examples_english: Community members support the family during a funeral.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtamfoɔ boa wɔ ayie mu?

definition_akan: Akan aduane yɛ nnuane ne nkyɛmu ahodoɔ a Akanfoɔ noa na wɔdi wɔ wɔn asetena mu.
definition_english: Akan food refers to traditional dishes and food practices associated with Akan communities.
explanation_akan: Akan aduane wɔ nsonsonoeɛ wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu na nnuane bi yɛ daa aduane.
examples_akan: Fufu ne nkwan yɛ aduane a nnipa pii di.
examples_english: Fufu with soup is eaten by many people.

definition_akan: Fufu yɛ aduane a wɔyɛ denam nnɔbaeɛ bi a wɔbɔ na wɔyam anaa wɔhyehyɛ so.
definition_english: Fufu is a traditional West African food prepared from starchy crops that are pounded or processed into a soft dough.
explanation_akan: Fufu taa ne nkwan di na nnuane a wɔde yɛ no betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Wɔtaa di fufu ne nkwan.
examples_english: Fufu is often eaten with soup.

definition_akan: Ampesi yɛ nnɔbaeɛ te sɛ borɔdeɛ anaa bayere a wɔanoa ma ɛyɛ aduane.
definition_english: Ampesi is a meal made from boiled starchy crops such as plantain or yam.
explanation_akan: Ampesi betumi ne nkwan, kontomire anaa aduanemmoa ahodoɔ adi.
examples_akan: Wɔde nkwan ne ampesi di.
examples_english: Ampesi may be eaten with soup.

definition_akan: Kontomire yɛ nhaban a wɔde yɛ aduane wɔ Ghana ne Akan mpɔtam pii.
definition_english: Kontomire refers to cocoyam leaves commonly used in Ghanaian cuisine.
explanation_akan: Wɔde kontomire yɛ nkwan ne nnuane ahodoɔ.
examples_akan: Wɔde kontomire yɛ aduane.
examples_english: Cocoyam leaves are used to prepare food.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔde kontomire yɛ aduane?

definition_akan: Bankye yɛ nnɔbaeɛ a wɔdua na wɔde yɛ nnuane ahodoɔ.
definition_english: Cassava is a root crop cultivated and used to prepare various foods.
explanation_akan: Bankye betumi ayɛ fufu, gari ne nnuane foforɔ mu adeɛ.
examples_akan: Wɔdua bankye de yɛ aduane.
examples_english: Cassava is grown and used in food preparation.

definition_akan: Kente yɛ ntoma a wɔnwene no kwan soronko mu na ɛwɔ amammerɛ mu nteaseɛ.
definition_english: Kente is a traditionally woven textile associated with Akan and other West African traditions.
explanation_akan: Kente wɔ nsusuiɛ ne kɔla ahodoɔ na wɔtaa de no yɛ ntadeɛ ma dwumadie titire.
examples_akan: Wɔtaa de kente yɛ ntadeɛ wɔ afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: Kente is often worn during festivals.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na kente ho hia?

definition_akan: Ntoma yɛ adeɛ a wɔnwene anaa wɔyɛ no de kata nipadua anaa yɛ ntadeɛ.
definition_english: Cloth is a woven or manufactured textile used for clothing and other purposes.
explanation_akan: Ntoma wɔ dwuma wɔ Akan amammerɛ mu wɔ ntadeɛ, afahyɛ ne amanneɛ mu.
examples_akan: Wɔde ntoma yɛ ntadeɛ.
examples_english: Cloth is used to make clothing.

definition_akan: Ntadeɛ yɛ nneɛma a nnipa hyɛ de kata wɔn nipadua.
definition_english: Clothing refers to garments worn to cover the body.
explanation_akan: Akan ntadeɛ betumi ayɛ daa ntadeɛ anaa amammerɛ mu ntadeɛ a wɔhyɛ wɔ dwumadie titire ase.
examples_akan: Nnipa hyɛ ntadeɛ wɔ afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: People wear traditional clothing during festivals.

definition_akan: Kente nwene yɛ adwuma a wɔde nhama ne nwene mfiri anaa nnwinnadeɛ yɛ kente ntoma.
definition_english: Kente weaving is the craft of producing Kente cloth through weaving techniques.
explanation_akan: Kente nwene hia nimdeɛ, ntoboaseɛ ne nsusuiɛ ho nteaseɛ.
examples_akan: Ɔnwenefoɔ nwene kente.
examples_english: A weaver produces Kente cloth.

definition_akan: Adinkra yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔde nsusuiɛ so kyerɛ nyansa, gyinapɛn ne asetena mu nsɛm.
definition_english: Adinkra refers to visual symbols used to communicate ideas, values, wisdom, and cultural concepts.
explanation_akan: Adinkra nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ ahodoɔ na wɔtaa hu wɔ ntoma ne nneɛma foforɔ so.
examples_akan: Wɔde Adinkra nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ gu ntoma so.
examples_english: Adinkra symbols are placed on cloth.

definition_akan: Adinkra nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ahodoɔ a wɔde kyerɛ adwene anaa gyinapɛn bi.
definition_english: Adinkra symbols are visual signs used to represent particular ideas or values.
explanation_akan: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi betumi ne nyansa, asomdwoeɛ, nkabom anaa ahobrɛaseɛ ayɛ adwene.
examples_akan: Adinkra nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi kyerɛ nyansa.
examples_english: Some Adinkra symbols communicate wisdom.

definition_akan: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yɛ agyiraeɛ anaa mfoni a ɛgyina hɔ ma adwene, adeɛ anaa nkyerɛaseɛ bi.
definition_english: A symbol is a sign or visual representation that stands for an idea, thing, or meaning.
explanation_akan: Adinkra yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ betumi de adwene adi nkitaho.
examples_akan: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ.
examples_english: A symbol may carry a particular meaning.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho hia?

definition_akan: Anansesɛm yɛ Akan amammerɛ mu anansesɛm a wɔde Ananse, nnipa anaa mmoa ho nsɛm kyerɛkyerɛ.
definition_english: Anansesɛm are Akan oral stories often involving Ananse, people, or animals.
explanation_akan: Anansesɛm taa wɔ adesua, afotuo anaa nyansa bi wɔ mu.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ ka anansesɛm kyerɛ mmofra.
examples_english: Elders tell Ananse stories to children.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na Akanfoɔ ka anansesɛm?

definition_akan: Ananse yɛ akyekyedeɛ a ɔwɔ dwuma titire wɔ Akan anansesɛm mu.
definition_english: Ananse is a spider character prominent in Akan storytelling traditions.
explanation_akan: Ananse ho nsɛm pii de nyansa, anifere, ɔbrasɛeɛ ne asetenam adesua kyerɛ.
examples_akan: Ananse yɛ onipa titire wɔ anansesɛm pii mu.
examples_english: Ananse is a central character in many folktales.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na Ananse wɔ anansesɛm mu?

definition_akan: Anansesɛm ka yɛ sɛnea wɔka anansesɛm kyerɛ afoforo de ma wɔnya anigyeɛ ne adesua.
definition_english: Storytelling is the practice of telling stories for entertainment, education, and cultural transmission.
explanation_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ betumi aka anansesɛm akyerɛ mmofra ma wɔasua suban ne nyansa.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ ka anansesɛm anwummere.
examples_english: Elders may tell stories in the evening.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na storytelling ho hia?

definition_akan: Anansesɛm mu adesua yɛ nyansa ne afotuo a wɔnya firi anansesɛm mu.
definition_english: Lessons in folktales are the wisdom and guidance communicated through traditional stories.
explanation_akan: Anansesɛm betumi akyerɛ mmofra nokware, nyansa, ntoboaseɛ ne ɔbra pa.
examples_akan: Mmofra nya adesua firi anansesɛm mu.
examples_english: Children can learn lessons from folktales.
question_patterns: Dɛn na yɛsua firi anansesɛm mu?

definition_akan: Mmebusɛm yɛ nsɛm tiawa a wɔde nyansa ne asetena mu nokware bi kyerɛ.
definition_english: Akan proverbs are concise expressions used to communicate wisdom and life lessons.
explanation_akan: Mmebusɛm wɔ dwuma wɔ afotuo, ɔkasa, asɛnka ne nkitahodie mu.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de mmebusɛm ma afotuo.
examples_english: Elders use proverbs to give advice.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na mmebusɛm ho hia?

definition_akan: Bɛ yɛ asɛm tiawa a ɛwɔ nkyerɛaseɛ anaa nyansa a wɔde kyerɛ adwene bi.
definition_english: A proverb is a short expression carrying a lesson or wisdom.
explanation_akan: Bɛ betumi ama ɔkasafoɔ ada asɛm tenten bi adi wɔ nsɛm kakraa bi mu.
examples_akan: Ɔpanyin de bɛ maa mmofra.
examples_english: The elder used a proverb when advising the children.

definition_akan: Mmebusɛm ne nyansa yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda Akan mmebusɛm ne asetena mu nyansa ntam.
definition_english: Proverbs and wisdom describes how proverbs communicate lessons and practical wisdom.
explanation_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de mmebusɛm tumi kyerɛ adwene bi a anka ɛbɛhia nsɛm pii.
examples_akan: Mmebusɛm tumi kyerɛ nyansa wɔ nsɛm tiawa mu.
examples_english: Proverbs can express wisdom in short statements.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmebusɛm kyerɛ nyansa?

definition_akan: Akan nnwom yɛ nnwom a wɔde nne, ntintim ne amammerɛ mu nsɛm ka.
definition_english: Akan music includes musical traditions using voice, rhythm, instruments, and cultural themes.
explanation_akan: Nnwom wɔ dwuma wɔ afahyɛ, ayie, awareɛ, ɔsom ne anigyeɛ mu.
examples_akan: Wɔto nnwom wɔ afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: People sing during festivals.
question_patterns: Ɛhe na Akanfoɔ de nnwom di dwuma?

definition_akan: Asaw yɛ nipadua mu nkitahodie a wɔde nnwom ne ntintim ka ho.
definition_english: Traditional dance is cultural expression through body movement, rhythm, and music.
explanation_akan: Akan asaw betumi ayɛ afahyɛ, ayie, awareɛ anaa anigyeɛ mu dwumadie.
examples_akan: Wɔasaw wɔ afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: People dance during festivals.

definition_akan: Ntwom yɛ ntintim anaa nnwom mu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma nnyegyeeɛ di akyi wɔ bere ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
definition_english: Rhythm refers to the organized pattern of beats in music or drumming.
explanation_akan: Ntintim ne asaw taa di akɔnnɔ wɔ amammerɛ mu dwumadie mu.
examples_akan: Ntintim ma asaw nya nhyehyɛeɛ.
examples_english: Rhythm gives structure to dance.

definition_akan: Ntintim yɛ nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde wɔn nsa anaa nnwinnadeɛ foforɔ bɔ de yɛ nnyegyeeɛ.
definition_english: Drumming is the practice of producing rhythmic sounds with drums or related instruments.
explanation_akan: Ntintim yɛ Akan amammerɛ mu nnwom ne asaw ho adeɛ a ɛho hia wɔ dwumadie pii mu.
examples_akan: Wɔbɔ mpintin wɔ afahyɛ ase.
examples_english: Drums may be played during festivals.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na ntintim ho hia?

definition_akan: Nkyea yɛ kasa ne nneyɛeɛ a wɔde kyerɛ obu, anigyeɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ ho anigyeɛ bere a wɔhyia.
definition_english: Greetings are verbal and social expressions showing respect, acknowledgement, and goodwill.
explanation_akan: Nkyea ho hia wɔ Akan asetena mu na mmofra sua sɛ wɔnkyea mpanyimfoɔ.
examples_akan: Abofra kyea ne panyin.
examples_english: A child greets an elder.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na nkyea ho hia?

definition_akan: Kyea yɛ sɛ obi de kasa anaa nneyɛeɛ kyerɛ sɛ wahu obi na obu no.
definition_english: To greet is to acknowledge another person respectfully when meeting them.
explanation_akan: Akanfoɔ taa bu nkyea sɛ ɛyɛ nkitahodie pa no mfitiaseɛ.
examples_akan: Abofra kyea mpanyimfoɔ.
examples_english: A child greets elders.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔkyea mpanyimfoɔ?

definition_akan: Ahɔhoyɛ yɛ suban a obi de gye ahɔhoɔ na ɔma wɔte nka sɛ wɔagye wɔn atom.
definition_english: Hospitality is the practice of welcoming and treating guests kindly.
explanation_akan: Ahɔhoyɛ yɛ suban a ɛboa ma ayɔnkofa ne nkitahodie yɛ den.
examples_akan: Abusua no gye ahɔhoɔ fɛw so.
examples_english: The family welcomes guests warmly.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na ahɔhoyɛ ho hia?

definition_akan: Ahɔhoɔ gye yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so ma ahɔhoɔ te nka sɛ wɔagye wɔn atom.
definition_english: Welcoming guests refers to practices used to make visitors feel accepted and comfortable.
explanation_akan: Ahɔhoɔ gye betumi ayɛ nkyea, nkɔmmɔ, aduane anaa mmoa.
examples_akan: Abusua no gye ahɔhoɔ fɛw so.
examples_english: The family welcomes guests warmly.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Akanfoɔ gye ahɔhoɔ?

definition_akan: Nkabom yɛ nnipa a wɔbom yɛ adwuma, boa wɔn ho na wɔdi wɔn botaeɛ ho dwuma.
definition_english: Community solidarity is people working together and supporting one another for shared goals.
explanation_akan: Nkabom ho hia wɔ ayie, awareɛ, afahyɛ ne mpɔtam mu nsɛnnennen mu.
examples_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ boa wɔn ho wɔ ayie ase.
examples_english: Community members support one another during funerals.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na nkabom ho hia?

definition_akan: Boa wɔn ho yɛ sɛ nnipa boa wɔn ho wɔ asɛyɛdeɛ, ɔhaw anaa botaeɛ bi ho.
definition_english: Mutual support means people helping one another with responsibilities, difficulties, or shared goals.
explanation_akan: Akan mpɔtam mu nnipa betumi aboaboa wɔn ano de boa abusua anaa mpɔtamfoɔ.
examples_akan: Nkurɔfoɔ boa wɔn ho wɔ adwuma mu.
examples_english: People help one another with work.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Akanfoɔ boa wɔn ho?

definition_akan: Mpɔtam yɛ beaeɛ a nnipa tena na wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho wɔ asetena mu.
definition_english: A community is a place or social group where people live and interact.
explanation_akan: Mpɔtam mu asetena ka abusua, adwuma, amanneɛ ne nkabom ho.
examples_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ hyia wɔ mpɔtam dwumadie ase.
examples_english: Community members gather for community activities.

definition_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ yɛ nnipa a wɔte mpɔtam baako anaa wɔka mpɔtam no ho.
definition_english: Community members are people who live in or belong to a community.
explanation_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ betumi ayɛ adwuma bom wɔ nneɛma a ɛfa wɔn mpɔtam ho.
examples_akan: Mpɔtamfoɔ yɛ adwuma bom.
examples_english: Community members work together.

definition_akan: Asetena mu adesua yɛ nimdeɛ ne suban a mmofra sua firi abusua, mpanyimfoɔ, adwuma ne asetena mu.
definition_english: Traditional education refers to knowledge, skills, and values learned through family, elders, work, stories, and community life.
explanation_akan: Akanfoɔ tete mu adesua nyɛ sukuu dan mu adesua nko.
examples_akan: Mmofra sua adwuma firi wɔn awofoɔ hɔ.
examples_english: Children learn skills from their parents.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Akanfoɔ tete kyerɛkyerɛ mmofra?

definition_akan: Awofoɔ adesua yɛ sɛnea awofoɔ de wɔn nimdeɛ ne osuahunu kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma.
definition_english: Parental teaching is the passing of knowledge and experience from parents to children.
explanation_akan: Awofoɔ tumi kyerɛ mmofra kasa, adwuma, obu, ahobrɛaseɛ ne asetena mu nyansa.
examples_akan: Awofoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma suban pa.
examples_english: Parents teach their children good behaviour.

definition_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ afotuo yɛ afotuo a mpanyimfoɔ de wɔn osuahunu ne nyansa ma mmofra anaa mpɔtamfoɔ.
definition_english: Elders' advice is guidance based on the experience and wisdom of older community members.
explanation_akan: Afotuo yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de nimdeɛ kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
examples_akan: Mpanyimfoɔ de afotuo ma mmofra.
examples_english: Elders give advice to younger people.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na mpanyimfoɔ afotuo ho hia?

definition_akan: Adwuma mu adesua yɛ nimdeɛ ne ahokeka a obi nya denam adwuma a ɔyɛ so.
definition_english: Learning through work is the acquisition of knowledge and practical skills through doing work.
explanation_akan: Tete Akan asetena mu no, mmofra betumi asua nnwuma bi denam wɔn awofoɔ anaa mpanyimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ wɔn so no so.
examples_akan: Abofra sua adwuma denam ɔhwɛ ne ɔyɛ so.
examples_english: A child can learn a skill by observing and practising it.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnipa sua adwuma?

definition_akan: Kuadwuma yɛ asase so adwuma a wɔyɛ de dua nnɔbaeɛ na nya nnuane anaa sika.
definition_english: Farming is the cultivation of land to produce crops for food, trade, or other purposes.
explanation_akan: Kuadwuma yɛ adwuma a ɛho hia wɔ mpɔtam pii na ɛma abusua nya nnuane.
examples_akan: Ɔkuafoɔ dua bankye.
examples_english: A farmer grows cassava.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na kuadwuma ho hia?

definition_akan: Ɔkuafoɔ yɛ obi a ɔyɛ kuadwuma de dua nnɔbaeɛ anaa yɛ nneɛma a ɛfa kuayɛ ho.
definition_english: A farmer is a person who cultivates land or engages in agricultural activities.
explanation_akan: Ɔkuafoɔ betumi dua nnɔbaeɛ ahodoɔ a abusua ne mpɔtam de di anaa wɔtɔn.
examples_akan: Ɔkuafoɔ dua nnɔbaeɛ wɔ ne kurom.
examples_english: The farmer grows crops in the community.

definition_akan: Adwumayɛ yɛ dwumadie a obi yɛ de nya nea ɔhia anaa di botaeɛ bi ho dwuma.
definition_english: Work refers to activities or occupations performed to meet needs or achieve purposes.
explanation_akan: Akan asetena mu adwumayɛ wɔ nkitahodie wɔ abusua, mpɔtam ne sikasɛm ho.
examples_akan: Adwumayɛ boa abusua ma wɔnya nea wɔhia.
examples_english: Work helps families obtain what they need.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na adwuma ho hia?

definition_akan: Nwenefoɔ yɛ obi a ɔnwene ntoma anaa nneɛma foforɔ a wɔde nwene yɛ.
definition_english: A weaver is a person who produces cloth or other woven items.
explanation_akan: Nwenefoɔ betumi anya nimdeɛ wɔ ntoma nwene mu na wɔde yɛ amammerɛ mu nneɛma.
examples_akan: Nwenefoɔ nwene ntoma.
examples_english: The weaver produces cloth.

definition_akan: Agyapadeɛ yɛ adeɛ, hokwan, asɛyɛdeɛ anaa amammerɛ a wɔde kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
definition_english: Inheritance can include property, rights, responsibilities, and cultural heritage passed between generations.
explanation_akan: Agyapadeɛ nyɛ sika anaa asase nko; ɛtumi ka amammerɛ ne asɛyɛdeɛ ho.
examples_akan: Agyapadeɛ betumi ayɛ amammerɛ a awofoɔ de ma wɔn mma.
examples_english: Inheritance can include cultural traditions passed to children.

definition_akan: Abusua agyapadeɛ yɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ abusua dea na wɔde kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
definition_english: Family inheritance refers to property, rights, or responsibilities associated with a family and passed across generations.
explanation_akan: Abusua agyapadeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mpɔtam ne abusua ahodoɔ mu.
examples_akan: Abusua no hwɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ so.
examples_english: The family manages its inheritance.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua agyapadeɛ kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so?

definition_akan: Amammerɛ agyapadeɛ yɛ amammerɛ, kasa, amanneɛ, abakɔsɛm ne nimdeɛ a awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ de ma wɔn a wɔba akyiri.
definition_english: Cultural heritage is the language, customs, history, knowledge, and traditions passed between generations.
explanation_akan: Amammerɛ agyapadeɛ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ nya kwan sua wɔn abusua ne mpɔtam ho nneɛma.
examples_akan: Kasa ne mmebusɛm yɛ amammerɛ agyapadeɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ.
examples_english: Language and proverbs can be examples of cultural heritage.

definition_akan: Akan kasa yɛ kasa a Akanfoɔ de di nkitahodie na ɛyɛ wɔn amammerɛ ne nipasu no fã.
definition_english: Akan is a language group used by Akan communities and is an important part of cultural identity.
explanation_akan: Akan kasa boa ma wɔde abakɔsɛm, mmebusɛm, nnwom, anansesɛm ne nimdeɛ kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
examples_akan: Akan kasa boa ma amammerɛ tena hɔ.
examples_english: Akan language helps preserve culture.

definition_akan: Twi yɛ Akan kasa ahodoɔ mu kasa a nnipa pii ka wɔ Ghana.
definition_english: Twi is an Akan language variety spoken widely in Ghana.
explanation_akan: Twi wɔ kasa mu nsonsonoeɛ ne mpɔtam mu nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ.
examples_akan: Nnipa pii ka Twi wɔ Ghana.
examples_english: Many people speak Twi in Ghana.

definition_akan: Kasa ne nipasu yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda kasa a nnipa ka ne wɔn amammerɛ mu nipasu ntam.
definition_english: Language and identity describes the relationship between language and cultural identity.
explanation_akan: Kasa boa ma nnipa de wɔn abakɔsɛm, amammerɛ ne gyinapɛn da adi.
examples_akan: Kasa yɛ amammerɛ mu nipasu no fã.
examples_english: Language is part of cultural identity.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa ne nipasu wɔ abusuabɔ?

definition_akan: Kasa kora amammerɛ yɛ sɛnea kasa boa ma wɔde amammerɛ, abakɔsɛm ne nyansa kɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
definition_english: Language as cultural preservation describes how language helps transmit culture, history, and wisdom.
explanation_akan: Mmebusɛm, anansesɛm ne nkyea yɛ nneɛma a kasa betumi de akora.
examples_akan: Kasa boa ma mmebusɛm tena hɔ.
examples_english: Language helps preserve proverbs.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa kora amammerɛ?

definition_akan: Mmofra nteteeɛ yɛ ɔkwan a abusua ne mpɔtam fa so kyerɛkyerɛ mmofra suban, asɛyɛdeɛ ne asetena.
definition_english: Child upbringing is the process through which families and communities teach children behaviour, responsibility, and social values.
explanation_akan: Mmofra nteteeɛ ka obu, ahobrɛaseɛ, adwuma, kasa ne afoforo ho nidi ho.
examples_akan: Awofoɔ de mmofra nteteeɛ kyerɛ wɔn mma suban pa.
examples_english: Parents teach children good behaviour through upbringing.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Akanfoɔ tete mmofra?

definition_akan: Mmofra suban yɛ nneyɛeɛ ne suban a mmofra da no adi wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam mu.
definition_english: Children's behaviour refers to the conduct children display within family and community life.
explanation_akan: Akan abusua betumi akyerɛ mmofra sɛ wɔnyɛ nokwafoɔ, wɔntie na wɔmmu mpanyimfoɔ.
examples_akan: Wɔkyerɛ mmofra suban pa.
examples_english: Children are taught good behaviour.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔkyerɛ mmofra suban pa?

definition_akan: Mmofra ne mpanyimfoɔ abusuabɔ yɛ nkitahodie a ɛda mmofra ne mpanyimfoɔ ntam wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam mu.
definition_english: The relationship between children and elders concerns interaction between younger and older members of the family or community.
explanation_akan: Abusuabɔ yi betumi ama mmofra anya afotuo ne amammerɛ ho nimdeɛ.
examples_akan: Mmofra sua afotuo firi mpanyimfoɔ hɔ.
examples_english: Children learn guidance from elders.
question_patterns: Dɛn ne mmofra ne mpanyimfoɔ abusuabɔ?

definition_akan: Nokware yɛ suban a obi ka nea ɛyɛ nokware na ɔnnnaadaa afoforo.
definition_english: Truthfulness is the value of speaking honestly and avoiding deception.
explanation_akan: Nokware yɛ gyinapɛn a ɛboa ma nkurɔfoɔ nya wɔn ho wɔn ho mu ahotosoɔ.
examples_akan: Nokware boa ma ahotosoɔ yɛ den.
examples_english: Truthfulness helps build trust.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na nokware ho hia?

definition_akan: Ayɛyie yɛ sɛ obi da anigyeɛ ne anisɔ adi wɔ adeɛ pa a obi ayɛ ho.
definition_english: Appreciation is expressing gratitude or recognition for something good someone has done.
explanation_akan: Ayɛyie betumi hyɛ nkabom ne ayɔnkofa den wɔ abusua ne mpɔtam mu.
examples_akan: Wɔde ayɛyie ma obi a ɔaboa wɔn.
examples_english: They show appreciation to someone who helped them.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛda ayɛyie adi?

definition_akan: Aseda yɛ sɛ obi da anisɔ adi wɔ mmoa, adom anaa adeɛ pa bi a wanya ho.
definition_english: Thankfulness is expressing gratitude for help, favour, or something good received.
explanation_akan: Aseda betumi ada adi wɔ kasa, nneyɛeɛ anaa amammerɛ mu dwumadie.
examples_akan: Ɔdaa aseda adi wɔ mmoa no ho.
examples_english: He expressed thanks for the help.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na aseda ho hia?

definition_akan: Nokwaredie yɛ suban a obi yɛ nokware wɔ ne kasa ne ne nneyɛeɛ mu.
definition_english: Honesty is the practice of being truthful in speech and conduct.
explanation_akan: Nokwaredie betumi aboa ma nnipa anya wɔn ho wɔn ho mu ahotosoɔ.
examples_akan: Nokwaredie yɛ suban pa.
examples_english: Honesty is considered a good quality.
question_patterns: Dɛn nti na honesty ho hia?

definition_akan: Ahotosoɔ yɛ gyidi a obi wɔ wɔ obi foforɔ anaa nkitahodie bi mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ.
definition_english: Trust is confidence in another person or relationship.
explanation_akan: Ahotosoɔ betumi ayɛ den denam nokwaredie, nokwafoɔyɛ ne asɛyɛdeɛ so.
examples_akan: Nokwaredie ma ahotosoɔ yɛ den.
examples_english: Honesty can strengthen trust.
question_patterns: Dɛn na ɛma ahotosoɔ yɛ den?

definition_akan: Amammerɛ ahwɛyiyeɛ yɛ mmɔden a nnipa yɛ de bɔ amammerɛ, kasa, abakɔsɛm ne amanneɛ ho ban.
definition_english: Cultural preservation is the effort to protect language, history, customs, and traditions for future generations.
explanation_akan: Kasa, nwoma, anansesɛm, mmebusɛm, nnwom ne afahyɛ betumi aboa ma amammerɛ tena hɔ.
examples_akan: Akan kasa sua ne kyerɛwtohɔ betumi aboa amammerɛ ahwɛyiyeɛ.
examples_english: Learning and documenting Akan can support cultural preservation.
question_patterns: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛbɛbɔ Akan amammerɛ ho ban?

definition_akan: Akan kasa kora yɛ mmɔden a wɔyɛ de ma Akan kasa tena hɔ na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ sua no.
